page.overview:
Who is Agent Fuse?

Agent Fuse is an Agents minifigure introduced in 2008.

In Agents 2.0, he wears body armour. Like other Agents, he has a dual-sided head, with the reverse side of his face showing him scared.

Agent Fuse is the team's computer, electronics, and explosives specialist. He is also a talented pilot.

In 2854298 The Adventures of Clutch Powers, he appears three different times. He first appears in the chapter "The LEGO Team," while walking down the street. Fuse appears again in the same chapter, watching the Grand Carousel. Fuse again appears in the chapter "Space Mission," waving Clutch and his team goodbye as they ride in the Galactic Enforcer.
